title: The Price of Rewriting Fate
next_chapter_hook: In that instant when the thread of cause and effect snapped, an will beyond mortal comprehension suddenly awakened. Chen Ji realized with a jolt—every attempt of his to rewrite fate had been feeding the slumbering monster.

text.content: The Dragon Vein power surged through his meridians like scalding magma, yet Chen Ji's spiritual sense caught that familiar aura deep within the ruins at that very moment—a cold fluctuation unique to the Demonic Path commander, resonating eerily with the dormant power in his bloodline. He unconsciously clenched his fists, knuckles white with tension. Twin of fate... Chen Nian, where are you? But before he could sort through his thoughts, the Tianji Record suddenly blazed hot, and on the yellowed pages emerged an image that made his heart stop: Ling Yuan was secretly setting up a lethal trap against the Tianqing Sect, and the activation time coincided precisely with three days later.

Chen Ji stared at the image, his pupils shrinking to dangerous pinpoints. Three days... If he let Ling Yuan succeed, the Tianqing Sect would face annihilation, and all his carefully laid plans would crumble. He drew a deep breath, fingertips gently stroking the yellowed edge of the Tianji Record, feeling that familiar yet alien force stirring beneath his skin. This was the first time he had glimpsed so clearly the possibility of rewriting fate—Ling Yuan's fate thread glowed within the Tianji Record like a fragile silk, ready to snap at any moment. But Mo Xiansheng's words pierced his mind like ice daggers: "The backlash of the shackles is more terrible than you imagine." A cold smile twisted Chen Ji's lips. He noted it. So what? Some debts always need someone to pay.

dialogue.content: Since I've seen it, there's no room for letting it go.

text.content: Chen Ji sat cross-legged, hands forming seals, the Tianji Record hovering three inches before his brow center. The yellowed pages fluttered without wind, golden runes slithering between lines of text like living creatures, each rune carrying the will of Heaven's Way. He closed his eyes, his spiritual sense an invisible blade, stabbing along that fate thread toward Ling Yuan's core of destiny. But the instant he touched the source of fate, a majestic will pressed down like a mountain—Ling Yuan's protective forbidden formations, thirty-six layers stacked, each condensed with that old sect master's lifelong心血. Chen Ji gritted his teeth, veins bulging on his forehead, pressing deeper. He had patience, he had means.

The seventeenth formation shattered under the Tianji Record's power, the twenty-third dissolved in the tremor of the fate thread. When Chen Ji's spiritual sense touched the thirty-fifth formation, an unprecedented sense of crisis struck—the breath beneath the formation suddenly surged, the seemingly fragile fate thread transforming in an instant into a ferocious blood-colored chain, ruthlessly striking back at his spiritual sense. Chen Ji realized something was wrong, but it was already too late to withdraw. That blood chain coiled around his spiritual sense, a searing pain exploding from his brow center and surging to every limb. The Tianji Record shuddered violently, golden runes clashing violently with the blood chain, bursting forth dazzling light.

"Break!" Chen Ji roared, pouring all his mental power into the Tianji Record. The yellowed pages suddenly blazed with blinding golden light, the thirty-six formations melting like snow before the scorching sun. Ling Yuan's fate thread lay exposed, like a dying earthworm trembling before Chen Ji's spiritual sense. He hesitated not, a thought moving, and that fate thread began to twist, snap, and reorganize under his will... The rewrite succeeded. But just as he prepared to withdraw his spiritual sense, a low clank of chains echoed from the depths of the Tianji Record, cold and majestic, as if from the Nine Heavens.

The backlash of the shackles came faster and more violently than he imagined. Almost the instant the fate thread broke, a jet-black chain shot out from the depths of the Tianji Record, coiling fiercely around Chen Ji's soul. The chain was ice-cold, each coil stealing a portion of his lifespan. Pain! Deep into the marrow! His face turned stark white, a thread of blood trickling from his lips, his body trembling violently. But he clenched his teeth, forcibly suppressing the backlash within, not letting out even a whimper. Three days of lifespan... Just three days, exchanged for Ling Yuan's fate rewrite—worth it.

dialogue.content: Boy, you shouldn't have been so hasty. Once the shackles stain you, they become like flesh-burrowing worms, impossible to root out.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted from the first page of the Tianji Record, his aged face full of complex emotions. He extended a虚幻 palm, gently touching the black chain coiling around Chen Ji's soul, only to be violently repelled the instant of contact. "What a Heavenly Eye... it hid the shackles so deeply." Mo Xiansheng muttered, his brow knitting into the character for mountain. "Every time fate is rewritten, the shackles absorb part of the backlash, growing stronger. And you, young man, are slowly awakening that slumbering monster with your lifespan and fortune."

Chen Ji wiped the blood from his lips, his pallid face revealing a hint of a playful smile. "Monster?" His voice was hoarse yet carried an unyielding resilience, "Since it's a monster, there's possibility of taming it." He struggled to sit upright, beginning to operate the Tianqing Sect's basic cultivation method to stabilize his chaotic true qi. Within his meridians, true qi ran wild like an unbridled horse, every meridian sending tearing agony. But within that agony, Chen Ji keenly sensed something amiss—the lifespan devoured by the shackles hadn't completely vanished, but transformed in an incomprehensible way into some primordial, fundamental power.

That is..." Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, an incredulous light flickering within. Deep within the chaos of his true qi, he sensed an extremely faint fluctuation of power transcending ordinary spiritual energy. That fluctuation was ancient and mysterious, as if from the dawn of heaven and earth, containing the ultimate secrets of fate. A chance for breakthrough! His heart surged with joy, yet he suppressed his emotions. This power was like a slumbering volcano, magma churning beneath the earth, waiting only for the right moment to erupt. What he needed now was time, a breather, to rebuild his strength before the enemy discovered his weakness.

But at this moment, an earth-shaking rumble echoed from deep within the ruins. The ground trembled violently, ancient walls sealed for ten thousand years cracking with fierce fissures. Chen Ji's expression shifted, his spiritual sense instantly extending outward—he sensed it, that familiar Demonic Path aura was rushing closer frantically, and the speed had increased tenfold or more! Twin of fate... Chen Nian? No, not Chen Nian. Though the aura shared the same bloodline source, it carried a cold, sinister demonic nature. Chen Ji forced himself to stand, the weakness from his chaotic true qi surging like a tide, yet the coldness in his eyes only grew fiercer. Good timing, let me test the mettle of these shackles.

The ruins' entrance collapsed under the Demonic Path aura's impact, a black figure stepping ghost-like from the dust. It was a man in black robes, his features surprisingly seven-tenths similar to Chen Ji's, only with more sinisterty and madness between his brows. His eyes were pure blood-red, a strange rune flickering within the depths of his pupils. "So it was you..." The black-robed man's voice was low and hoarse, carrying inexplicable complex emotions, "My dear brother, I knew you were still alive." Chen Ji's eyes narrowed, but within his heart was a storm—Brother? He never knew he had a younger brother. The chessboard of fate seemed far more intricate than he imagined.

But at this moment, the black chain deep within Chen Ji's soul suddenly tightened, a sharp agony spreading from his brow center to every limb. He groaned, his figure staggering slightly, his face growing paler still. The black-robed man's eyes flashed with a playful smile. "Seems brother just completed an unpleasant transaction." He approached slowly, each step carrying heavy oppression, "The Heavenly Eye's shackles... Tsk tsk, if I haven't guessed wrong, you've been trading your lifespan and fortune for that so-called fate-rewriting ability, yes?" Chen Ji said nothing, only coldly staring at his opponent. He was weak to the extreme, true qi chaotic, lifespan draining. Facing this sudden "brother," he had almost no strength to fight back.

In that critical moment, countless thoughts flashed through Chen Ji's mind. Force a breakthrough, use that just-sensed primordial power to forcibly suppress the shackles' backlash, perhaps briefly restoring combat ability—but he understood clearly the consequences: the shackles would further strengthen, and his death prophecy would accelerate its arrival. Alternatively, suppress and wait, preserve strength, seek a better opportunity... A struggle flickered in the depths of his eyes, ultimately dissolving into resolute cold light. He had noted it, noted all the debts, all the people. Once he survived this ordeal, those who owed him would pay them back, item by item.

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath, making a mad decision. He no longer suppressed that primordial power, but actively guided it to strike the black shackles deep within his soul. In an instant, his body blazed with dazzling golden light, the true qi in his meridians surging like boiling magma. The black shackles shrieked under that power's impact, yet didn't break—instead they wound tighter, lacerating his soul with blood. Pain! Deep into the marrow! But Chen Ji gritted his teeth, forcibly guiding that power toward his limbs. His eyes turned pure gold, his aura soaring madly, recovering to peak state in an instant.

dialogue.content: Want to see my trump card? You're not qualified yet.

choices.description: Conceal your aura to appear weak before the enemy, secretly accumulate strength to find weaknesses

text.content: Chen Ji forcibly suppressed the power churning within him, choosing to endure. He let the chaotic true qi leak out, staggering backward two steps, feigning a posture of severe injury and inability to continue. Upon seeing this, the black-robed man's vigilance clearly relaxed. "I thought brother might have some heaven-shaking move, turns out just a spent arrow." He laughed loudly as he approached, completely unaware that this "waste" was secretly observing every one of his movements, every footfall. Within Chen Ji's eyes, cold light flickered like a serpent's tongue. Weakness... he found it.

dialogue.content: (Cold smirk in his heart) Brother dear, you really think I came unprepared?

text.content: But whatever choice he made, Chen Ji understood one thing—the shackles within the Tianji Record had awakened, and that will beyond mortal comprehension had certainly sensed his existence. That was the Heavenly Eye, the ultimate controller of his fate. Chen Ji raised his head toward the void, as if seeing those无形 eyes coldly watching him. That gaze carried no emotion, only cold observation and final judgment. He silently noted in his heart: Someday, he would personally strangle those eyes, letting it know—fate has never been a plaything to be manipulated at will.

The moment Chen Ji faced the black-robed man, an eerie fluctuation suddenly erupted from the depths of the Tianji Record. That fluctuation was cold and vast, as if from the Nine Heavens above, or from the Nine Abysses below. Chen Ji's soul shuddered violently, a bone-deep chill spreading from his feet to the crown of his head. He sensed it—in that void depths, a pair of eyes watched him. That gaze carried no emotion, only cold observation and final judgment—the Heavenly Eye, the ultimate controller of his fate. The shackles coiled tighter around his soul, as if warning, as if mocking.

A majestic power descended from the heavens, slamming down onto Chen Ji's soul.

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath, completely收敛 his soul power. That majestic will surged like a tide, yet under his deliberate concealment, gradually lost its target. In the void depths, those无形 eyes narrowed slightly, as if wondering why its prey had suddenly vanished. After a moment, the oppressive gaze slowly faded, but Chen Ji knew this was merely a temporary retreat. The Heavenly Eye had never given up—it was merely waiting for a better opportunity.

Just when Chen Ji thought everything had settled, a low cold laugh suddenly echoed from the depths of the Tianji Record. That laughter was ice-cold and familiar, as if from ancient primordial times, as if whispering right beside his ear. Chen Ji's pupils contracted violently—that was the Heavenly Eye's voice, the supreme existence he thought existed only in legend. "Interesting little bug... you think you can escape the chess game?" The voice reverberated through Chen Ji's mind, each word thundering in his ears, "The shackles have awakened, fate has been rewritten... and you are merely the next sacrifice about to be reaped." The words fell, and Chen Ji felt the black shackles deep within his soul suddenly tighten, a pain ten times more intense than before席卷 his entire body.
